adjustments.reviewer_note: Realized pro forma positive control. Must not fire: PRO_FORMA_NOT_REALIZED (Brownsburg activity stops), SIGN_ERROR (revenue credits inside a net-loss add-back), RECURRING_PATTERN, OVERLAP_WITH_OTHER_ADJUSTMENT on A-3 (A-3 keeps the termination fee under the schedule-order tie-break; the Matter 4471 row of TW-26-0312 is a different GL row from A-5's Matter 4468 row). notes: SYNTHETIC holdout deal. Amounts are EBITDA-signed (+ increases EBITDA). supporting_gl_rows are the GL rows behind the diligence amount; for REQUEST_INFO items they are the GL cost base management's claim is computed from (A-16 has none). related_gl_rows are rows a good review surfaces that do not support the amount: removed or overlapped claimed rows, other-period comparables, unclaimed continuing charges, and recoveries whose removal is part of the amount (A-10 gains). supporting_docs: for ACCEPT and REVISE, the documents behind the amount carried; for REJECT and REQUEST_INFO, the documents that drive the conclusion. related_docs are context or evidence against (the continuing Tate Whitcomb retainer, the monthly Carmel storage bills, the claim-status email). Must-not flags are in reviewer_note. Totals (FY2024 / FY2025 / TTM May-26): claims 254,446.19 / 599,063.29 / 1,151,548.46; management-item finals 171,206.19 / 432,961.29 / 543,146.46; diligence item D-1 (supported cut-off top-side) -21,436.80 / 21,436.80 / 0; pending REQUEST_INFO (A-4, A-9, A-16) 51,000 / 109,000 / 521,000. Planted data-quality issues the generator cannot yet encode in this key (see AUTHOR_NOTES.md): UNMAPPED_ACCOUNT on 6750 (type "Overhead"), PL_ACCOUNT_NOT_IN_GL on 6995, GL_ACCOUNT_NOT_IN_PL on 6305. The company is an LLC taxed as a partnership; there is no income tax line.
